name: The Bright Path
detailed_description:
"The Bright Path" is an educational game, which provides interactive experience to learn more about the topics of drug abuse, drug addiction, dangerous societal phenomena and active citizenship in an interactive, entertaining and immersive way. We recommend to follow-up with a reflection activity to discuss the choices you made during the game. The game is mainly intended for teenagers and young adults who do not have a deep knowledge about the dangers of drug abuse and addictions and it helps them to raise their awareness about the situations which may lead to addiction and the dangers which come with using addictive substances. The game is not intended for education of professionals in the field or university students who are experts on the subject. The game was created in collaboration with local teenagers and young adults in our community.You play as a young man called Rasmus, who is a  volunteer in a fictional city called „Sobercity“, which is plagued by drug abuse, drug addiction and other dangerous societal phenomena. Your goal is to roam through the city and discover local citizens, who are facing various challenges and to help them or not, but remember every choice you make counts towards shaping the fate of the city !

The game offers the following features and content: 

  • open world/sandbox mechanics 

  • play time of around 45 minutes 

  • meeting NPCs, helping them with their quests and challenges 

  • collecting collectible items such as podcasts, journals and other items 

  • discover 3 different endings based on the actions you take during the game 

  • adventure/exploration gameplay 

  • learning more about the dangers of drug abuse and active citizenship in a fun way

short_description: "The bright path" is a 45 minutes long educational interactive computer game for Windows which you can use to familiarize yourselves or other unexperienced youngsters with the topics of dangers of drug abuse, addiction and active citizenships in your communities.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit or newer
  • Processor: Modern x64 CPU 4 core CPU (Ryzen 3 series or Intel equivalent ) or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4GB VRAM or higher (dedicated GPU is highly recommended) - Nvidia Geforce GTX1050 or AMD/Intel equivalent recommended or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game only supports resolutions and monitors with a 16:9 aspect ratio, starting from 1280x720, 1366x768, 1600x900, 1920x1080 and higher. If you are using a monitor with an aspect ratio other than 16:9 and are experiencing issues, go to the game settings after launching the game and change the resolution to one of the supported 16:9 options.
